description.html: The porous mask is a face-shaped decoration with eye openings, a pronounced nose and a surface covered in small holes, which makes it resemble old, worn stone or an ancient artifact. Its sandy beige color blends naturally with desert substrates, stones and dry wood.

You can lay the mask on the terrarium floor or lean it against a stone or the back wall, where it creates the impression of ruins and gives the setup a story. It looks best as a single standout piece, with a few stones and plants, rather than among a pile of other ornaments. It suits terrariums for geckos, agamas, spiders and other animals that do well in a dry, sandy setup.

Before first use, wash the mask in lukewarm water and dry it well. If you lean it against a wall or stone, make sure it stands firmly and cannot fall on the animal while it climbs or digs. Because of the porous surface, dust and substrate collect in the holes, so take it out from time to time and clean it with a soft brush under running water. See our other terrarium supplies too.
